name: Flesh Golem
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Aversion to Fire
traits.desc: After taking Fire damage, the golem has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Berserk
traits.desc: When the golem starts its turn Bloodied, it may go berserk and attack the nearest creature it can see.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.desc: Lightning damage heals the golem instead of harming it.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes two Slam attacks.

desc: Stitched together from the dead and woken by lightning. It remembers nothing, except pain and fire.
